blocks.text: Fe'l + kishi + to: boshqa odamning harakati

I **want to go** — men o'zim bormoqchiman; I **want you to go** — sen borishingni xohlayman. Bu qolip qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 53-dars). O'zbekchada ikkinchi harakatning egasi egalik qo'shimchasi bilan beriladi: bor**ishing**ni, kel**ishi**ni, yordam ber**ishi**ni so'radi — yoki «-sin deb»: kelsin deb aytdi. Bu darsda fe'llarni to'rt guruhga ajratamiz: (1) kishi ixtiyoriy — want, ask, expect; (2) kishi shart — tell, remind, persuade, force; (3) kishisiz -ing, kishi bilan to — advise, allow; (4) to siz — make, let. Har bir guruhning o'z tuzog'i bor.
1. Kishi ixtiyoriy: want, ask, expect, would like

**ask** ga alohida e'tibor bering. **ask to do** — o'zim nimadir qilishim uchun ruxsat so'rash: She **asked to speak** to the manager — «Menejer bilan gaplashishni so'radi» (o'zi gaplashmoqchi). **ask somebody to do** — boshqa kishidan iltimos: She **asked the manager to speak** to us — «Menejerdan biz bilan gaplashishini so'radi». **want** dan keyin hech qachon that-gap kelmaydi: «I want that you come» — xato, faqat I **want you to come**.

items.text: I **asked to see** the doctor, but the receptionist was very rude.
items.translation: Shifokorni **ko'rishni so'radim**, lekin qabulxonadagi xodim juda qo'pol edi.

items.text: I **asked the receptionist to call** the doctor, and she refused.
items.translation: Qabulxonadagi xodimdan shifokorni **chaqirishini so'radim**, u esa rad etdi.

items.text: Economists **expect prices to fall** after the new year.
items.translation: Iqtisodchilar yangi yildan keyin narxlar **tushishini kutishyapti**.

blocks.text: 2. Kishi shart: tell, remind, warn, persuade, force, get

Bu fe'llardan keyin kishi **albatta** aytiladi — kimga aytdi, kimni ko'ndirdi, kimni majbur qildi: tell **somebody** to, remind **somebody** to, warn **somebody** (not) to, invite, persuade (ko'ndirmoq), convince, force (majbur qilmoq), encourage (ruhlantirmoq), enable (imkon bermoq), teach, order. **get somebody to do** — so'zlashuvda «ko'ndirib, qildirmoq»: o'zbekchadagi orttirma nisbatga juda yaqin — I **got a mechanic to check** the brakes — «Tormozlarni ustaga **tekshirtirdim**».

rows: The nurse **told me to lie** down.
They **warned us not to swim** there.
The rain **forced us to cancel** the match.
Yomg'ir bizni o'yinni **bekor qilishga majbur qildi**.
The loan **enabled them to open** a shop.
I **got a mechanic to check** the brakes.

blocks.text: 3. advise, allow, forbid: -ing yoki kishi + to

**advise, encourage, allow, permit, forbid** ikki xil keladi. Kishi aytilmasa — **-ing**: They don't **allow smoking** here (umuman, hech kimga). Kishi aytilsa — **kishi + to**: They don't **allow us to smoke** here. «They don't allow to smoke» — xato: to faqat kishidan keyin keladi. Majhul nisbatda kishi egaga aylanadi va to qoladi: We **aren't allowed to smoke** here. Bu shakl o'zbekchadagi «... ga ruxsat berilmaydi» ga mos va kundalik nutqda juda ko'p ishlatiladi (→ 42-dars).

items.text: The guide **advised wearing** comfortable shoes for the walk up to the fortress.
items.translation: Gid qal'agacha piyoda chiqish uchun qulay poyabzal **kiyishni maslahat berdi**.

items.text: The guide **advised us to wear** hats because the sun was very strong.
items.translation: Quyosh juda qattiq bo'lgani uchun gid bizga **shlyapa kiyishimizni maslahat berdi**.

items.text: Children **aren't allowed to swim** in the pool without an adult.

blocks.text: **say** va **suggest** bu qolipda ishlatilmaydi. «He said me to wait» → He **told me to wait** yoki He **said (that)** I should wait. «She suggested me to go» → She **suggested (that)** I go (→ 53-dars). **explain** ham kishi + to olmaydi: «Explain me to do it» — xato.
4. make va let: to siz — lekin majhulda boshqacha

**make somebody do** — majbur qilmoq yoki biror holatga solmoq; **let somebody do** — ruxsat bermoq, qo'yib bermoq. Ikkalasidan keyin ham **to qo'yilmaydi**. O'zbekchada make ko'pincha orttirma nisbatga to'g'ri keladi: kul**dir**di, yig'la**t**di, kut**tir**di, qayta qil**dir**di. **What made you ...?** — «Sizni ... ga nima undadi?» degan juda foydali savol: What **made you choose** this job? Ikki muhim nozik joy: (1) **make** majhul nisbatda **to** ni qaytarib oladi: They **made us wait** → We **were made to wait**. (2) **let** ning majhuli yo'q, o'rniga **be allowed to** ishlatiladi: «I was let to leave» — xato, I **was allowed to leave**. **help** dan keyin to ixtiyoriy: She **helped me (to) carry** the bags.

items.text: The film was so boring that it **made me fall** asleep halfway through.
items.translation: Film shunchalik zerikarli ediki, yarmiga kelib meni **uxlatib qo'ydi**.

items.text: Our teacher **let us use** dictionaries in the final exam.
items.translation: O'qituvchimiz yakuniy imtihonda lug'atdan **foydalanishimizga ruxsat berdi**.

items.text: We **were made to fill in** the same form three times at the embassy.
items.translation: Elchixonada bizni bitta anketani uch marta **to'ldirishga majbur qilishdi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I want that you help me.» → I **want you to help** me.; «She told me go home.» → She **told me to go** home.; «He said me to wait.» → He **told me to wait**.; «My boss made me to stay late.» → My boss **made me stay** late.; «They let us to leave.» → They **let us leave**.; «I was let to go.» → I **was allowed to go**.; «They don't allow to park here.» → They don't **allow parking** / **allow people to park** here.; «I want you don't worry.» → I **don't want you to worry**.

Eslab qolish: o'zbekchada «-ish**ini** / -ish**imni** + so'radi / aytdi / xohladi» — kishi + **to**. Orttirma nisbat (kul**dir**di, kut**tir**di, tekshir**tir**dim) bo'lsa — **make** yoki **get**: make + to siz, get + to bilan. «Ruxsat berdi» — **let** (to siz) yoki **allow** (to bilan); «ruxsat berildi» — faqat **was allowed to**.

rows: want, ask, expect, would like, help
tell, remind, warn, persuade, force, encourage, enable, teach, get
They **allow smoking**. / They **allow us to smoke**.
be told / asked / made / allowed + to

examples.title: **want**, **would like**, **expect** somebody **to**
examples.description: Boshqa odamdan kutilgan yoki istalgan harakat: want / would like / expect / need + kishi + to. O'zbekchada «-ishini xohlaydi / kutadi».

sentences.text: My parents **want me to become** a doctor, but I'm more interested in design.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **shifokor bo'lishimni xohlaydi**, lekin menga ko'proq dizayn qiziq.

sentences.text: I'd **like you to meet** our new marketing director, Sarah Collins.
sentences.translation: Sizni yangi marketing direktorimiz Sara Kollinz bilan **tanishtirib qo'ymoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Nobody **expected Aziz to win** the competition — he only started boxing a year ago.
sentences.translation: Hech kim Azizning musobaqada **g'olib chiqishini kutmagan edi** — u boksni bir yil oldin boshlagan.

sentences.text: Do you **want me to pick** you **up** from the station, or will you take a taxi?
sentences.translation: Sizni vokzaldan **olib ketaymi** yoki taksida kelasizmi?

sentences.text: The company **expects all employees to attend** the training next week.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya kelasi haftadagi treningda **barcha xodimlar qatnashishini kutadi**.

sentences.text: Would you **like us to bring** anything to the barbecue? — Just some drinks.
sentences.translation: Barbekyuga biror narsa **olib kelaylikmi**? — Faqat ichimlik.

sentences.text: I don't **want you to think** that I'm not grateful for your help.
sentences.translation: Yordamingiz uchun minnatdor emasman, deb **o'ylashingizni xohlamayman**.

sentences.text: Kate **would prefer her son to study** closer to home.
sentences.translation: Keyt o'g'lining uyga yaqinroq joyda **o'qishini afzal ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: The teacher **wants everyone to hand in** their essays by Friday.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi **hamma** inshosini juma kunigacha **topshirishini xohlaydi**.

sentences.text: We **need someone to look after** the dog while we're in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Edinburgdaligimizda itga **qarab turadigan odam kerak**.

examples.title: **tell**, **ask**, **remind**, **warn** somebody (**not**) **to**
examples.description: Ko'rsatma, iltimos, eslatma va ogohlantirish. ask to (o'zim) va ask somebody to (boshqasi) farqi; inkor — kishi + **not to**.

sentences.text: The pilot **told passengers to fasten** their seatbelts because of the turbulence.
sentences.translation: Uchuvchi turbulentlik sababli yo'lovchilarga **kamarlarni taqishni aytdi**.

sentences.text: Could you **remind me to send** the invoice to the client tomorrow morning?
sentences.translation: Ertaga ertalab mijozga hisob-fakturani **yuborishimni eslatib qo'ya olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Our guide **warned us not to drink** the tap water.
sentences.translation: Gidimiz bizni **jo'mrak suvini ichmaslik haqida ogohlantirdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **asked her brother to help** her move the furniture.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza akasidan mebellarni ko'chirishga **yordam berishini so'radi**.

sentences.text: She **asked to speak** to the manager, not to an assistant.
sentences.translation: U yordamchi bilan emas, menejer bilan **gaplashishni so'radi**.

sentences.text: How many times have I **told you not to leave** your shoes in the hall?
sentences.translation: Senga necha marta poyabzalingni dahlizda **qoldirma deb aytdim**?

sentences.text: The police **are asking anyone** who saw the accident **to contact** them.
sentences.translation: Politsiya baxtsiz hodisani ko'rgan **har bir kishidan ular bilan bog'lanishni so'ramoqda**.

sentences.text: Remind the kids **to take** their swimming things on Wednesday.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga chorshanba kuni suzish anjomlarini **olishlarini eslatib qo'y**.

sentences.text: My doctor **warned me to be** careful with salt after the blood test.
sentences.translation: Qon tahlilidan keyin shifokor meni tuzga **ehtiyot bo'lishim haqida ogohlantirdi**.

sentences.text: Who **told you to switch off** the server? Now nobody can work!
sentences.translation: Serverni **o'chirishni** senga kim **aytdi**? Endi hech kim ishlay olmaydi!

examples.title: **persuade**, **encourage**, **force**, **get** somebody **to**
examples.description: Kimnidir ko'ndirish (persuade, convince), ruhlantirish (encourage, urge), majburlash (force) va «qildirish» (get somebody to do — orttirma nisbat).

sentences.text: It took me weeks to **persuade my dad to buy** a smartphone.
sentences.translation: Dadamni smartfon **sotib olishga ko'ndirish** uchun bir necha hafta vaqt ketdi.

sentences.text: Our English teacher **encouraged us to read** a newspaper every day.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili o'qituvchimiz bizni har kuni gazeta **o'qishga undardi**.

sentences.text: The heavy snow **forced us to spend** the night at the airport.
sentences.translation: Kuchli qor bizni tunni aeroportda **o'tkazishga majbur qildi**.

sentences.text: I finally **got the landlord to repair** the heating, but it took three phone calls.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat isitishni uy egasiga **ta'mirlatdim**, lekin buning uchun uch marta qo'ng'iroq qilishga to'g'ri keldi.

sentences.text: Can you **get Oliver to send** me the photos from the conference?
sentences.translation: Oliverga konferensiyadagi suratlarni menga **yuborishini tayinlay olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Nobody **forced you to sign** the contract, so don't complain now.
sentences.translation: Shartnomani **imzolashga** seni hech kim **majburlamagan**, endi shikoyat qilma.

sentences.text: Madina's success **encouraged other girls in her village to apply** to university.
sentences.translation: Madinaning muvaffaqiyati qishlog'idagi boshqa qizlarni ham universitetga **hujjat topshirishga ruhlantirdi**.

sentences.text: Have you **convinced Bekzod to come** with us to Khiva?
sentences.translation: Bekzodni biz bilan Xivaga **borishga ko'ndira oldingmi**?

sentences.text: Rising rents **have forced many small shops to close** in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Ijara narxining oshishi shahar markazidagi ko'plab kichik do'konlarni **yopilishga majbur qildi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **urged her brother to see** a doctor about his cough.
sentences.translation: Sara akasini yo'tali sababli **shifokorga borishga qattiq undadi**.

examples.title: **allow**, **enable**, **teach**, **invite** somebody **to**
examples.description: Ruxsat (allow, forbid), imkoniyat (enable), o'rgatish (teach) va taklif (invite) — kishi + to. O'zbekchada «-ishga ruxsat / imkon berdi».

sentences.text: This new app **enables users to pay** their bills in seconds.
sentences.translation: Bu yangi ilova foydalanuvchilarga to'lovlarni bir necha soniyada **amalga oshirish imkonini beradi**.

sentences.text: My uncle **taught me to fish** when we were on holiday near Lake Charvak.
sentences.translation: Chorvoq ko'li yaqinida dam olganimizda amakim menga **baliq tutishni o'rgatgan**.

sentences.text: Our manager **allows us to leave** early on Fridays if the work is done.
sentences.translation: Ish bitgan bo'lsa, rahbarimiz juma kunlari **erta ketishimizga ruxsat beradi**.

sentences.text: The Smiths **have invited us to stay** at their cottage in the Lake District.
sentences.translation: Smitlar bizni Leyk Distriktdagi dala hovlilarida **mehmon bo'lishga taklif qilishdi**.

sentences.text: A scholarship **enabled Nilufar to study** at Edinburgh University.
sentences.translation: Grant Nilufarga Edinburg universitetida **o'qish imkonini berdi**.

sentences.text: Does the hotel **allow guests to bring** pets? — Only small dogs, I think.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona mehmonlarga uy hayvonlarini **olib kelishga ruxsat beradimi**? — Menimcha, faqat kichik itlarni.

sentences.text: The law **forbids shops to sell** alcohol to anyone under eighteen.
sentences.translation: Qonun do'konlarga o'n sakkiz yoshgacha bo'lganlarga spirtli ichimlik **sotishni taqiqlaydi**.

sentences.text: Who **taught you to speak** Russian so well? — My grandmother, mostly.
sentences.translation: Senga rus tilida bunchalik yaxshi **gapirishni** kim **o'rgatdi**? — Asosan buvim.

sentences.text: Better roads **would allow farmers to get** their fruit to the market faster.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiroq yo'llar fermerlarga mevalarini bozorga tezroq **yetkazish imkonini berardi**.

sentences.text: Last month the university **invited Professor Brown to give** a lecture on climate change.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy universitet professor Braunni iqlim o'zgarishi haqida **ma'ruza o'qishga taklif qildi**.

examples.title: **advise**, **recommend**, **allow**: -ing or person + **to**
examples.description: Kishi aytilmasa — -ing (allow smoking), kishi aytilsa — kishi + to (allow us to smoke). Juft gaplarda farqni solishtiring.

sentences.text: The doctor **advised drinking** plenty of water during the heatwave.
sentences.translation: Shifokor jazirama paytida ko'p **suv ichishni maslahat berdi**.

sentences.text: The doctor **advised Grandma to stay** indoors until the evening.
sentences.translation: Shifokor buvimga kechgacha **uyda o'tirishni maslahat berdi**.

sentences.text: They don't **allow smoking** anywhere on the university campus.
sentences.translation: Universitet hududining hech bir joyida **chekishga ruxsat berilmaydi**.

sentences.text: They don't even **allow students to smoke** outside the main gate.
sentences.translation: Hatto asosiy darvoza tashqarisida ham **talabalarga chekishga ruxsat berishmaydi**.

sentences.text: I wouldn't **recommend booking** that hotel — the rooms are tiny.
sentences.translation: O'sha mehmonxonani **bron qilishni tavsiya qilmayman** — xonalari juda kichkina.

sentences.text: Experts **advise people to change** their passwords every few months.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislar **parollarni** har bir necha oyda **almashtirib turishni maslahat berishadi**.

sentences.text: Our teacher **encourages asking** questions, even silly ones.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz **savol berishni rag'batlantiradi**, hatto bema'ni savollarni ham.

sentences.text: Would you **advise me to accept** the offer, or should I wait?
sentences.translation: Taklifni **qabul qilishimni maslahat berasizmi** yoki kutib turaymi?

sentences.text: The rules **permit each passenger to take** one small bag on board.
sentences.translation: Qoidalar har bir yo'lovchiga samolyotga bitta kichik sumka **olib chiqishga ruxsat beradi**.

sentences.text: Most fitness trainers **recommend warming up** for ten minutes before you start.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik fitnes murabbiylari mashg'ulotdan oldin o'n daqiqa **qizishib olishni tavsiya qiladi**.

examples.title: **make**, **let**, **help**: no **to**
examples.description: make somebody do — majbur qilish yoki holatga solish (o'zbekchada ko'pincha orttirma nisbat), let somebody do — ruxsat berish; help dan keyin to ixtiyoriy.

sentences.text: The sad ending **made** half the audience **cry**.
sentences.translation: Qayg'uli yakun tomoshabinlarning yarmini **yig'latdi**.

sentences.text: My boss **made me redo** the whole presentation because of one mistake.
sentences.translation: Bitta xato tufayli boshlig'im taqdimotni boshidan **qayta qildirdi**.

sentences.text: Will your parents **let you travel** to London on your own?
sentences.translation: Ota-onang Londonga yolg'iz **borishingga ruxsat berishadimi**?

sentences.text: What **made you change** your mind about the job in Bukhara?
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi ish haqidagi **fikringizni nima o'zgartirdi**?

sentences.text: Don't **let the children play** near the road — it's dangerous.
sentences.translation: Bolalarning yo'l yaqinida **o'ynashiga yo'l qo'ymang** — bu xavfli.

sentences.text: Jasur **helped his neighbour carry** the shopping up to the fifth floor.
sentences.translation: Jasur qo'shnisiga xaridlarni beshinchi qavatga **olib chiqishga yordam berdi**.

sentences.text: **Let me know** when you arrive in Samarkand, so I don't worry.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmasligim uchun Samarqandga yetib borganingizda **xabar bering**.

sentences.text: The smell of fresh bread **makes me feel** hungry even after dinner.
sentences.translation: Yangi non hidi kechki ovqatdan keyin ham **qornimni ochirib yuboradi**.

sentences.text: Our coach **made us run** ten laps because we were late for training.
sentences.translation: Mashg'ulotga kechikkanimiz uchun murabbiyimiz bizni **o'n aylana yugurtirdi**.

sentences.text: This free course **helped thousands of people find** jobs in IT.
sentences.translation: Bu bepul kurs minglab odamlarga IT sohasida **ish topishga yordam berdi**.

examples.title: Passive: **was told to**, **were made to**, **was allowed to**
examples.description: Majhul nisbatda kishi egaga aylanadi va to saqlanadi. make → be made **to**; let ning majhuli yo'q — be allowed to.

sentences.text: All passengers **were asked to switch off** their phones during take-off.
sentences.translation: Barcha yo'lovchilardan uchish paytida telefonlarini **o'chirib qo'yish so'raldi**.

sentences.text: At the border we **were made to wait** for three hours in the sun.
sentences.translation: Chegarada bizni quyosh tagida uch soat **kuttirishdi**.

sentences.text: As a child, I **wasn't allowed to watch** television on school nights.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda maktab kunlari kechqurun **televizor ko'rishga ruxsat yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Visitors **are reminded to keep** their tickets until the end of the tour.
sentences.translation: Tashrif buyuruvchilarga sayohat oxirigacha chiptalarini **saqlab qo'yish eslatiladi**.

sentences.text: Were you **told to bring** your passport to the interview? — Yes, and two photos.
sentences.translation: Suhbatga pasportingizni **olib kelishingiz aytilganmidi**? — Ha, yana ikkita surat ham.

sentences.text: Bekzod **was made to apologise** to the whole class for his rude comment.
sentences.translation: Qo'pol gapi uchun Bekzodni butun sinfdan **kechirim so'rashga majbur qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Residents **have been advised to stay** indoors because of the smoke from the fire.
sentences.translation: Yong'in tutuni sababli aholiga **uydan chiqmaslik tavsiya qilindi**.

sentences.text: We **weren't allowed to take** photos inside the old palace in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi eski saroy ichida **suratga olishga ruxsat berishmadi**.

sentences.text: Staff **are expected to arrive** at least ten minutes before their shift.
sentences.translation: Xodimlar smenadan kamida o'n daqiqa oldin **kelishlari kutiladi**.

sentences.text: Emma **was persuaded to stand** for the student council, and she won easily.
sentences.translation: Emmani talabalar kengashiga **nomzodini qo'yishga ko'ndirishdi**, u esa osongina g'alaba qozondi.

examples.title: Dialogue: can I go to the concert?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ona va o'smir qiz suhbati — let, want somebody to, would like somebody to, remind, persuade, make, expect.

sentences.text: — Mum, will you **let me go** to the concert in Tashkent on Saturday?
sentences.translation: — Oyi, shanba kuni Toshkentdagi konsertga **borishimga ruxsat berasizmi**?

sentences.text: — Who **invited you to go**? I don't **want you to travel** alone at night.
sentences.translation: — Seni kim **chaqirdi**? Kechasi yolg'iz **yurishingni xohlamayman**.

sentences.text: — Madina invited me, and her dad **has offered to drive** us both ways.
sentences.translation: — Madina chaqirdi, dadasi esa bizni **olib borib, olib kelishni o'z zimmasiga oldi**.

sentences.text: — Then I'd **like her father to call** me first, so we can agree on the times.
sentences.translation: — Unda avval Madinaning dadasi menga **qo'ng'iroq qilishini istardim**, vaqtni kelishib olamiz.

sentences.text: — Fine. And can you **remind Dad to transfer** me some money for the ticket?
sentences.translation: — Xo'p. Dadamga chipta uchun pul **o'tkazishini eslatib qo'yasizmi**?

sentences.text: — Hmm. Last time you **persuaded him to pay**, you spent it all on clothes.
sentences.translation: — Hm. O'tgan safar uni pul **berishga ko'ndirganingda**, hammasini kiyimga sarflagansan.

sentences.text: — That was different! The sale **made me buy** that jacket — it was half price!
sentences.translation: — U boshqa gap! Chegirma meni o'sha kurtkani **sotib olishga majbur qildi** — yarim narxda edi!

sentences.text: — Ha! Okay, but I **expect you to text** me when you get there.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Mayli, lekin u yerga yetib borganingda **menga xabar yozishingni kutaman**.

sentences.text: — Of course. And I promise I won't **let my phone die** this time.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Bu safar telefonimning **quvvati tugab qolishiga yo'l qo'ymayman**, va'da.

sentences.text: — Good. And don't **let anyone persuade you to stay** out late afterwards.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Konsertdan keyin hech kim seni kechgacha **qolishga ko'ndirmasin**.
